subheadings.subheading_title: 1.1 Docker Services Architecture & Compose Setup (mongo, mongo-express, etl_net, mongo_data)

screenshots.caption: Figure 1: Docker Compose override defining mongo, mongo-express, named volume mongo_data, and named network etl_net.
Figure 2: Active Docker services validating container status, named network etl_net, and named volume mongo_data.
Figure 3: Verification of .env.example template and proof that .env is ignored by Git using git check-ignore.
Figure 4: Astro CLI development environment initialization and startup via astro dev start.
